title: Where Is Your OneCoin Sign Up Link To Share
description: Subscribe to the channel and review more videos.

And I would first say that if you're on the one coins partners team you certainly want to consider using the lead capture page system. We offer everybody a free lead capture page system that has certainly proven to work. Its always recommended that you use a lead capture page so you can capture the information and that way you'll be able to follow-up as well as having a email series drip on that person over a number of days However, as far as also sharing your one coin sign up link with People that you'd like to share that with you can simply come into your account Click here on your profile go to the main information Go to the main information and You see it right here your invite link is right here And so you can simply copy this and give that to anybody that you would like Here's also another we have another video here on the YouTube channel where we show manually signing people up using the network tree right here the my network and the network tree but also you might notice here you can also click right here on this blue button to sign up a new member what you just want to make sure is that you have the placement of new members set to the side where they should be going and if you don't understand this strategy you need to watch the other videos on this youtube channel or maybe even get with your sponsor or other upline support but for the purpose of this video where is your onecoin link to share to get people to sign up directly with you it's right here under the profile and main information

visual.observation: An account dashboard displays monetary and points-related figures, including "TOTAL BONUS EARNED THIS WEEK" and "TOTAL BONUS EARNED". A profile page separately shows an invite link and the instruction "Click here to sign up a new member with you as a sponsor"; the dashboard also shows a sponsored-member count.
visual.context: The material is shown as an account dashboard and profile/settings interface. The recruitment wording appears as an on-screen instruction within the platform interface; whether the bonus figures are conditioned on recruitment is unclear.
visual.potential_relevance: A recruitment action is presented alongside bonus-related figures and sponsorship metrics, creating an observable reward-and-recruitment relationship that may merit review.
visual.limitations: These frames do not establish that joining or sponsoring a member causes any bonus, that the displayed figures are withdrawable funds, or that any transaction, signup, or outcome occurred.

visual_context_notes.observation: The profile/settings page visibly includes an "Invite link" section, placement settings for new members, and an "Auto buy" section with options including Tokens and Casino.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it actively promotes recruiting people into a OneCoin affiliate network through a sponsor invite link, lead-capture funnel, follow-up messaging, and placement of new members. It presents recruitment-linked dashboard metrics such as bonus earnings and sponsored members while instructing the viewer how to sign up additional participants, making the central activity a network-based earning solicitation rather than a neutral account tutorial.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the video describes affiliate recruitment through sponsors and uplines, instructs the speaker to place new members in a network tree, and connects that structure with bonus earnings and sponsored-member metrics shown in the account interface.
